name: Imperial Mask
oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, if it's not a token, each of your teammates creates a token that's a copy of this enchantment.
You have hexproof. (You can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
blocked_sentences: When this enchantment enters, if it's not a token, each of your teammates creates a token that's a copy of this enchantment.

needs.what: a player spec "teammate" (each player on your team other than you, rule 810 Two-Headed Giant / team variants) usable as `players` in `for_each_player` and as `controller` on `copy_permanent`, so the copy is created under each teammate's control; it resolves to no players in free-for-all
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Player specs offer only you, opponent, any and targets; the engine has no team concept, so every other player is an opponent and `for_each_player` over "opponent" would hand copies to enemies. The "You have hexproof" line is expressible with the `player_hexproof` static, and the "if it's not a token" intervening if with a self `is_token` check, but the card cannot be written partially
